method: Source JS question, choices, answer, solution and original PNG inspected separately. A PASS_STATIC_FIELDS finding checks actual drawing-model fields; it does not assert visual SVG/render parity, which remains for Antigravity.

axisCodeLegend.EXEMPT: This axis is verbal, algebraic or tabular; a geometry SVG adds no required graphic feature.
axisCodeLegend.PLAN: Executable production plan exists; sourceConditions and engine drawing fields independently reviewed.
axisCodeLegend.PLAN_SOURCE_CONFLICT: Executable plan follows the original raster graphic; source question or explanation contradicts that graphic.
axisCodeLegend.PLAN_ENGINE_PENDING: Executable partial plan exists, but one required visible feature needs an engine extension.
axisCodeLegend.ENGINE_CAPABILITY_PENDING: The complete source drawing cannot be expressed faithfully by the current production engine; original PNG preserved.
axisCodeLegend.SOURCE_CORRECTION_PENDING: Existing JS explanation conflicts with the original plotted quantities. A new solution image cannot legitimately claim full source parity.
